briefing: - 今日未见KEV在野利用或勒索软件标记，但高危批量发布。
- 批量公告集中在未授权、路径遍历、RCE注入，互联网暴露需优先检查。
- 最需立即处置：CVE-2026-101894已有POC，路径遍历可任意文件读取。
- 反序列化、命令注入与SQL注入均≥9.3，应优先补丁并收敛暴露面。
- 文件读取与链接绕过集中出现，重点核查上传下载和容器虚拟化。

items.title: LXD迁移接收路径绕过可root任意写文件
items.title_zh: LXD迁移接收路径绕过可root任意写文件
items.summary_zh: 有项目实例创建权限的认证客户端或恶意迁移源，借迁移路径符号链接解析缺陷以root写任意文件，完全接管主机。
items.repro_note: 认证客户端创建实例或自定义卷触发迁移接收，构造符号链接条目写root路径
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚拟化宿主机，越权即失守
items.description: Improper link resolution in the migration receive path in Canonical LXD versions 4.0 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client that can create instances or custom storage volumes in a project, or a malicious migration source server, to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary paths on the target host as root, leading to full host compromise.

items.title: Logsign SIEM默认口令可未授权登录
items.title_zh: Logsign SIEM默认口令可未授权登录
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用默认账号口令可直接登录暴露在网的Logsign SIEM，获取日志告警数据乃至系统控制权。
items.action_zh: 升级到6.4.117，立即修改默认口令并收敛管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 对暴露的SIEM登录页尝试默认账号口令，如admin/admin组合
items.impact_scope: SIEM日志平台，常含敏感日志
items.description: Use of default credentials vulnerability in Innotim Software, Telecommunications and Consultancy Trade Ltd. Co. Logsign SIEM allows Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords. This issue affects Logsign SIEM: from 6.4.101 before 6.4.117.

items.title: LXD btrfs路径遍历可root删文件
items.title_zh: LXD btrfs路径遍历可root删文件
items.summary_zh: 具备项目实例创建权限的认证客户端经btrfs存储驱动路径遍历，以root删除主机任意文件，导致主机不可用。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.repro_note: 认证客户端创建btrfs存储池实例，构造越界路径删除主机文件
items.impact_scope: 容器宿主机，认证用户可毁主机
items.description: Path traversal in the btrfs storage driver in Canonical LXD versions 4.0.2 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client with permission to create instances in a project to delete arbitrary files on the host as root. The client does this with a crafted subvolume path containing ../ sequences, sent in either of two ways: in the optimized_header.yaml of an optimized btrfs backup, or in the btrfs migration header sent by a malicious migration source.

items.title: Rancher未授权设置更新致存储型XSS
items.title_zh: Rancher未授权设置更新致存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可更新公开UI设置注入存储型XSS，管理员打开页面后会话被劫持，集群管理权可能失守。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.repro_note: 未授权调用公开UI设置更新接口写入XSS载荷，待管理员查看
items.impact_scope: K8s管理控制台，管理员会话
items.description: An unauthenticated update of public UI settings could be used by remote attackers to execute a stored cross-site scripting attack in the Rancher UI, in SUSE Rancher 2.15 before 2.15.2, 2.14 before 2.14.6, 2.13 before 2.13.10, 2.12 before 2.12.14 and 2.11 before 2.11.18.

items.title: 归档解压符号链接链绕过致任意文件读写
items.title_zh: 归档解压符号链接链绕过致任意文件读写
items.summary_zh: 攻击者提交含链式符号链接的压缩包，解压时写出目录外，可覆盖启动脚本与配置实现远程代码执行。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级受影响解压组件，禁用自动解压并校验归档内容
items.repro_note: 向解压/导入功能提交含链式符号链接的归档，观察写出目录外
items.impact_scope: 解压/导入组件，供应链入口
items.description: An attacker can supply a crafted archive containing chained symlink entries so that a later entry resolves outside the output directory. This allows files outside output to be read or written, and overwriting startup scripts or configuration can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Bluehood仪表盘缺失认证可篡改数据
items.title_zh: Bluehood仪表盘缺失认证可篡改数据
items.summary_zh: 同网段攻击者无需Cookie即可访问Bluehood仪表盘，读取蓝牙追踪数据并篡改心跳、留存与设备配置。
items.action_zh: 为仪表盘启用认证并限制访问来源，关注官方修复
items.repro_note: 不带Cookie直接请求仪表盘端口接口，读取并修改配置
items.impact_scope: 内网蓝牙监控面板，暴露即泄露
items.description: Bluehood monitors local bluetooth activity. A network attacker reachable on the dashboard port could read Bluetooth tracking data and modify application state — including the heartbeat URL, prune retention, device groups, and per-device notes — without a session cookie.

items.title: Roller OAuth授权错误可劫持管理员
items.title_zh: Roller OAuth授权错误可劫持管理员
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者获知未使用请求令牌后，可提交未签名授权请求将其绑定到管理员等任意账号，实现账号接管。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级至Apache Roller修复版本，校验授权签名
items.repro_note: 获取未使用request token后向OAuth 1.0a授权端点提交未签名请求
items.impact_scope: 开源博客系统，多面向公网
items.description: Incorrect Authorization in the OAuth 1.0a authorization endpoint of Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker who learns an outstanding request token for a configured site-wide consumer to bind that token to an arbitrary user account, including an administrator, by submitting an unsigned authorization request. Only installations that configure an OAuth 1.0a site-wide consumer are affected, and exploitation requires knowledge of one of its outstanding request tokens.

items.title: GCP应用集成越权可调用内部RPC
items.title_zh: GCP应用集成越权可调用内部RPC
items.summary_zh: 已认证GCP用户借助任务配置越权，以特权身份在谷歌生产网内调用内部RPC，可能横向影响共享环境。
items.action_zh: 谷歌已修复，审计2026-06-17前任务配置与权限
items.repro_note: 已认证账号在应用集成创建内部任务类型，观察内部RPC调用
items.impact_scope: 谷歌云托管服务，生产内部网络
items.description: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in the task configuration in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-17 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated Google Cloud user to execute arbitrary internal RPCs from inside Google's production network under a privileged identity using an internal-only task type. This vulnerability was patched on 17 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: GCP应用集成JS任务反序列化RCE
items.title_zh: GCP应用集成JS任务反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 具标准权限的已认证用户提交特制JS任务，绕过参数校验在共享生产服务器上执行任意代码。
items.action_zh: 谷歌已修复，审计2026-06-28前JS任务与权限
items.repro_note: 标准权限账号提交特制JS任务脚本，绕过参数校验执行代码
items.impact_scope: 谷歌云托管服务，共享生产服务器
items.description: A Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the JavaScript Task in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-28 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated user with standard permissions to run arbitrary code on the shared production servers using a specially crafted script bypassing param guards. This vulnerability was patched on 28 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Dayforce密码找回盲注SQL注入
items.title_zh: Dayforce密码找回盲注SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向密码找回接口参数注入SQL语句，经时间盲注逐字窃取数据库数据。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商确认修复，临时限制密码找回接口暴露
items.repro_note: 未认证GET密码找回接口，参数注入时间盲注SQL语句
items.impact_scope: 云端薪酬SaaS，存敏感员工数据
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Time Based-Blind SQL Injection in password recovery functionality. The unauthenticated attacker can prepare GET request with one of the parameters filled in with an arbitrary SQL query. The parameter is interpreted as part of SQL predicate resulting in Time-Based Blind SQL Injection. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: WatchGuard AP内部API鉴权缺失
items.title_zh: WatchGuard AP内部API鉴权缺失
items.summary_zh: 具备网络可达性的未认证攻击者可越权获取AP内部API的有效会话，为后续命令执行铺路。
items.action_zh: 升级AP固件至最新版，隔离AP管理网络
items.repro_note: 网络可达AP后直接请求内部API接口获取会话凭证
items.impact_scope: 企业无线AP，内网可直达
items.description: An improper access control vulnerability in an internal API service on WatchGuard Access Points allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the AP to obtain a valid API session.

items.title: WatchGuard AP命令注入致RCE
items.title_zh: WatchGuard AP命令注入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 网络可达的攻击者通过AP内部API注入系统命令，以底层操作系统权限执行任意shell命令。
items.action_zh: 升级AP固件至最新版，限制内部API网络访问
items.repro_note: 网络可达AP，向内部API接口参数注入shell命令
items.impact_scope: 企业无线AP，内网接入设备
items.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in the WatchGuard AP internal API service allows an attacker with network access to the AP to execute arbitrary shell commands on the underlying operating system.

items.title: Dayforce文件下载路径遍历任意读文件
items.title_zh: Dayforce文件下载路径遍历任意读文件
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者构造含绝对路径的文件下载请求，读取服务器任意文件，泄露配置与凭据。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 联系厂商确认修复，限制下载接口公网访问
items.repro_note: 未认证GET文件下载接口，file参数填绝对路径如/etc/passwd
items.impact_scope: 云端薪酬SaaS，服务器文件
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Path Traversal in file download functionality. An unauthenticated attacker can sent GET request with file path parameter set to any path including an absolute local file path. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: aaPanel面板命令注入可执行任意命令
items.title_zh: aaPanel面板命令注入可执行任意命令
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控制split_file_path参数，在aaPanel管理面板服务器上注入并执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 升级至最新版本，限制面板端口公网访问
items.repro_note: 调用面板相关接口并控制split_file_path参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: 服务器运维面板，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was found in aaPanel BaoTa up to 11.8.0. Impacted is the function merge_split_file of the file /www/server/panel/class/files.py of the component File Merge Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument split_file_path results in command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: D-Link DI-8400 Web服务栈溢出
items.title_zh: D-Link DI-8400 Web服务栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向NAT相关ASP接口opt参数发送超长数据触发栈溢出，可致设备崩溃或被控，利用已公开。
items.action_zh: 设备已停维护，建议替换并限制管理面暴露
items.repro_note: POST menu_nat_more.asp的opt参数超长数据触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: 已停维护家用/小型路由器
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DI-8400 16.07. This vulnerability affects the function menu_nat_more_asp of the file menu_nat_more.asp of the component Web Administration Service. The manipulation of the argument opt results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: ZHOME USB管理API命令注入
items.title_zh: ZHOME USB管理API命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控制USB设备管理API的path参数，在ZHOME网关设备上注入并执行系统命令。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，限制USB管理API访问并隔离设备
items.repro_note: 向USB设备管理API提交path参数注入系统命令
items.impact_scope: 智能家居网关，内网设备
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function pop_usb_device of the file usr/lib/lua/luci/controller/api/zrUsb.lua of the component USB Device Management API. This manipulation of the argument path causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZHOME firstLogin参数命令注入
items.title_zh: ZHOME firstLogin参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控制firstLogin参数，在ZHOME设备上注入系统命令，远程获得设备控制权。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，隔离设备并限制管理接口访问
items.repro_note: 调用firstLogin相关接口注入命令参数
items.impact_scope: 智能家居/宽带网关设备
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstLogin. Performing a manipulation of the argument firstLogin results in command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZHOME WiFi首次配置参数命令注入
items.title_zh: ZHOME WiFi首次配置参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向WiFi首次配置接口login_pwd注入命令，可在设备上执行任意指令，利用已公开。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，隔离设备并限制配置接口访问
items.repro_note: 向firstSetup_wifi接口login_pwd参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: 智能家居网关，内网可触达
items.description: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstSetup_wifi. Executing a manipulation of the argument login_pwd can lead to command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZHOME ip参数命令注入可远程执行
items.title_zh: ZHOME ip参数命令注入可远程执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可控制ip参数，在ZHOME设备接口注入并执行系统命令，利用代码已公开流传。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，隔离设备并限制接口暴露
items.repro_note: 向相关接口的ip参数注入系统命令并验证回显
items.impact_scope: 智能家居网关设备
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /api/ZRQos/set_online_client. The manipulation of the argument ip leads to command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZHOME MAC参数命令注入可远程
items.title_zh: ZHOME MAC参数命令注入可远程
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者向set_online_client接口mac参数注入命令，在ZHOME设备上执行任意指令，利用已公开。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，隔离设备并限制接口访问
items.repro_note: 向set_online_client接口mac参数注入系统命令
items.impact_scope: 智能家居网关设备
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /api/ZRQos/set_online_client. The manipulation of the argument mac results in command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: ZHOME set_passwd远程命令注入
items.title_zh: ZHOME set_passwd远程命令注入
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过/api/ZRnetwork/set_passwd的password1参数注入，执行任意系统命令。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复；限制该接口公网访问，对password1参数做过滤并加WAF规则。
items.repro_note: /api/ZRnetwork/set_passwd，password1注入命令
items.impact_scope: 智能家居设备，可能公网/内网暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /api/ZRnetwork/set_passwd. This manipulation of the argument password1 causes command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
